sentences.text: The Millers is an American sitcom that was created by Greg Garcia and stars Will Arnett as Nathan Miller and Margo Martindale as Carol Miller .	Greg Garcia	Greg Garcia (producer)	Will Arnett	Will Arnett	Margo Martindale	Margo Martindale	sitcom	sitcom
The multi-camera series aired from October 3 , 2013 to July 18 , 2015 and ran 34 episodes over two seasons on CBS .	CBS	CBS	multi-camera	Multiple-camera setup
CBS announced the cancellation of The Millers on November 14 , 2014 , four episodes into the show 's second season .	CBS	CBS
The series filmed their final episode on November 17 , 2014 .
Eleven episodes were produced during season 2 before production shut down .

The producers decided to finish the episode `` Hero '' , which was underway at the time for the financial sake of the below the line crew members that had already worked on the episode for several days .	below the line	Below the line (filmmaking)

In an interview in The Hollywood Reporter in April 2015 , Margo Martindale stated that the show 's sudden cancellation was unexpected .	Margo Martindale	Margo Martindale	The Hollywood Reporter	The Hollywood Reporter
